dex.entry: A small fossil-shrimp kin that has come back to life; its carapace is the hard chalk-white of ancient bone-stone and it navigates by vibrating its antennae against rock. The little fossil come to life — ancient and delicate, like holding deep time.

art.silhouette: Trilobite-like segmented body in pale bone-white chalk; two long swept-back antennae; multiple small legs; small eyes set in a wide flat head; delicate and prehistoric in feel.
